description: Diagrams for the AI Slides `diagram` layout (Phase DG). The text form is a Mermaid flowchart subset with comment directives — see wizard/prompts/slides.deck.md §Diagrams for the grammar. `starter` is what Insert ▸ Diagram places; `examples` are the four diagrams rebuilt from the 2026-11-05 whiteboard deck, used as the acceptance fixtures (DiagramTextCodecTests / DiagramLayoutTests read this file) and as reference material for prompt work. Structure only: no coordinate anywhere.
